name: HUMS2025
description: A challenge dataset (HUMS2025) used to evaluate medical imaging algorithms on the tasks defined by the data challenge.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient / IoU for segmentation; AUC / accuracy for classification; mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection (challenge may report a subset of these)
reputation: A domain-specific medical imaging challenge with limited public adoption so far (preprint-stage), intended for clinical research groups and specialized algorithm developers.
notes: Clinical data challenge — non-LLM benchmark. Potential issues include limited dataset size, label variability across annotators, and risk of overfitting to leaderboard data if not properly split; exact metrics depend on the specific task tracks.
